name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-record-update-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions"; value:cloneReadOnly is absent.
reason: The asserted panic on updating e3.name depends on e1.cloneReadOnly() producing an immutable record. cloneReadOnly is absent from both the supported lang.value functions and the langlib method-call allowlist, so this essential operation is outside subset 10.
unsupported_constructs: lang.value cloneReadOnly invoked with method syntax; immutable clone used to provoke a field-update panic
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation on e3.name assignment asserts runtime rejection of mutation after cloning.
